headline: Fronts Flare as Casualties Mount Across Contested Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the picture has sharpened on several fronts. Nevish Line, which previously surged, now shows a cooler one‑hour toll — ten Colonial and six Warden dead per hour — though the two‑hour trend still signals accelerating losses for both sides and rising enlistments. Linn Mercy remains a furnace: the latest hour records sixty‑four Colonial and two‑hundred‑eleven Warden casualties with enlistments climbing to thirty‑eight per hour, all marked accelerating. Weathered Expanse continues its brutal exchange, adding twenty‑seven Colonial and thirty‑three Warden dead in the most recent hour and pulling in thirteen new enlistees, both trends accelerating. Callahans Passage grinds on, posting one‑hundred‑four Colonial and seventy‑six Warden losses per hour with enlistments rising to twenty‑seven. Callums Cape erupts anew, the latest hour delivering six‑hundred‑thirty‑one Colonial and seven‑hundred‑forty‑two Warden casualties while enlistments jump to one‑hundred‑nine. Marban Hollow, Mooring County and Stlican Shelf also report climbing casualties and accelerating recruitment, feeding fresh manpower into the contested sectors. Overall enlistments are up across the active theatres, sustaining the high‑intensity fighting.
